Fix this why you stop? Complete end to end now, FINAL IVX REGISTRATION + SIGN-UP + SIGN-IN CERTIFICATION
TEMPORARILY ACTIVATE AMAZON SES EMAIL FOR COMPLETE TESTING

PRIORITY: P0 CRITICAL
SCOPE: AUTHENTICATION ONLY

Stop all work on:

- payments
- Tokenized transactions
- JV funding
- buyer payments
- Reels enhancements
- new modules
- growth automation
- visual polish unrelated to authentication

Do not resume other work until registration, verification, login,
password recovery, sessions, and role routing are certified.

The objective is:

0 KNOWN CRITICAL AUTHENTICATION DEFECTS
0 FAILED REQUIRED TEST CASES
0 ORPHAN IDENTITIES
0 DUPLICATE REGISTRATIONS
100% PASS ON THE MANDATORY AUTH MATRIX

Do not promise literal zero future errors.
Prove zero failures in the defined production certification matrix.

==================================================
1. TEMPORARILY ACTIVATE AMAZON SES
==================================================

Use Amazon SES as the temporary transactional email provider for:

- registration verification
- resend verification
- password reset
- email-change confirmation
- security notifications
- test-account notifications

Before asking the owner for credentials:

1. Inspect IVX Variables.
2. Inspect AWS variables.
3. Inspect Render environment variables.
4. Inspect Supabase SMTP configuration.
5. Inspect Route 53 DNS records.
6. Inspect existing SES identities.
7. Verify whether SES is in sandbox or production mode.
8. Verify the approved AWS region.
9. Return the exact missing or invalid configuration.

Do not expose secret values.

Expected secure variables may include:

AWS_SES_REGION
AWS_SES_SMTP_HOST
AWS_SES_SMTP_PORT
AWS_SES_SMTP_USERNAME
AWS_SES_SMTP_PASSWORD
AWS_SES_FROM_EMAIL
AWS_SES_FROM_NAME

Use existing canonical variable names where they differ.

Return:

VARIABLE:
EXISTS:
BOUND TO:
ENVIRONMENT:
FINGERPRINT:
SAFE TEST:
RESULT:
OWNER ACTION REQUIRED:

==================================================
2. AMAZON SES CONFIGURATION
==================================================

Configure:

- verified sending domain
- verified From address
- SPF
- DKIM
- DMARC
- MAIL FROM domain where applicable
- bounce handling
- complaint handling
- suppression handling
- sending region
- TLS
- correct SMTP port
- correct sender identity

Preferred sender:

IVX Holdings
no-reply@approved-ivx-domain

Also configure a monitored support/reply address where appropriate.

Do not send authentication emails from a personal address.

==================================================
3. SES SANDBOX RULE
==================================================

If Amazon SES remains in sandbox:

- use verified recipient email addresses for testing;
- clearly label the environment as SES_TEST_MODE;
- complete all test flows using approved test addresses;
- prepare the production-access request;
- do not claim unrestricted public email delivery.

Use statuses:

SES_NOT_CONFIGURED
SES_TEST_MODE
SES_PRODUCTION_READY
SES_LIVE
SES_BLOCKED

==================================================
4. SUPABASE SMTP CONNECTION
==================================================

Connect Amazon SES SMTP to the correct production Supabase Auth project.

Verify:

SMTP HOST
SMTP PORT
SMTP USER
SMTP PASSWORD BINDING
FROM ADDRESS
FROM NAME
RATE LIMITS
EMAIL TEMPLATE URLs
REDIRECT URLs
SITE URL

Do not modify the wrong Supabase project.

Confirm that Android, iOS, web, landing, Render, and IVX IA Chat all use
the same approved production Supabase project.

==================================================
5. CANONICAL USER ROLES
==================================================

Complete registration and login for:

1. MEMBER
2. INVESTOR
3. BUYER
4. JV_PARTNER
5. TOKENIZED_INVESTOR
6. BROKER
7. AGENT
8. LAND_OWNER

Owner and Admin are not public registration roles.

OWNER:
- securely provisioned
- standard email/password login
- password recovery
- owner authorization

ADMIN:
- assigned only by Owner
- never self-selected during public registration

==================================================
6. CANONICAL REGISTRATION FLOW
==================================================

Every registration must follow:

FORM
→ VALIDATION
→ DUPLICATE CHECK
→ IDEMPOTENCY CHECK
→ SUPABASE AUTH USER
→ PROFILE
→ MEMBER
→ ROLE
→ ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
→ EMAIL VERIFICATION
→ AUDIT EVENT
→ SAFE RESPONSE

Required records:

MEMBER:
auth.users
profiles
members
user role

INVESTOR:
all member records
investors record

BUYER:
all member records
buyers record

JV_PARTNER:
all member records
JV partner record

TOKENIZED_INVESTOR:
all member records
tokenized investor/waitlist record

BROKER:
all member records
broker record

AGENT:
all member records
agent record

LAND_OWNER:
all member records
land owner record

==================================================
7. REGISTRATION FORM REQUIREMENTS
==================================================

Required fields:

- first name
- last name
- email
- phone
- password
- password confirmation
- selected role
- ZIP/postal code where required
- terms acceptance
- privacy acceptance

Optional:

- profile picture
- company
- referral source

Validation:

- normalized lowercase email
- trimmed email
- E.164 phone normalization
- password strength
- password confirmation
- valid role
- valid name
- duplicate email
- duplicate phone
- terms accepted

Never trim intentional internal password characters.
Only reject accidental leading/trailing spaces with clear behavior.

==================================================
8. REGISTRATION TRANSACTION SAFETY
==================================================

Implement:

- idempotency key
- duplicate-submit prevention
- unique normalized email
- approved unique phone rule
- database transaction
- compensating cleanup
- retry-safe workflow
- exact failure stage
- rollback status
- trace ID

Required states:

STARTED
AUTH_CREATED
PROFILE_CREATED
MEMBER_CREATED
ROLE_ASSIGNED
ROLE_RECORD_CREATED
VERIFICATION_SENT
COMPLETED
FAILED
ROLLED_BACK

If any required step fails, do not leave:

- orphan auth user
- orphan profile
- member without auth user
- member without role
- role record without member
- duplicate identity

==================================================
9. EMAIL VERIFICATION
==================================================

Complete:

REGISTER
→ SES EMAIL DELIVERED
→ USER OPENS LINK
→ SUPABASE CALLBACK
→ EMAIL CONFIRMED
→ APP/WEB RETURNS
→ SESSION OR SIGN-IN SCREEN
→ CORRECT DASHBOARD

Test:

- real email delivered
- correct sender
- correct subject
- correct branding
- valid link
- expired link
- reused link
- malformed link
- Android deep link
- iOS universal link where available
- web callback
- Instagram browser behavior
- resend verification
- resend rate limit

Do not mark PASS because Supabase returned HTTP 200.
Verify real mailbox delivery and link completion.

==================================================
10. SIGN-IN FLOW
==================================================

Canonical sign-in:

EMAIL
→ PASSWORD
→ SUPABASE AUTH
→ SESSION
→ SERVER IDENTITY CHECK
→ PROFILE
→ MEMBER
→ ROLE
→ ROLE-SPECIFIC RECORD
→ DASHBOARD

Test every role.

Expected routing:

OWNER → Owner Dashboard
ADMIN → Admin Hub
MEMBER → Member Home
INVESTOR → Investor Dashboard
BUYER → Buyer Dashboard
JV_PARTNER → JV Dashboard
TOKENIZED_INVESTOR → Tokenized Dashboard
BROKER → Broker Dashboard
AGENT → Agent Dashboard
LAND_OWNER → Land Owner/JV Dashboard

==================================================
11. OWNER LOGIN
==================================================

Verify:

- known owner password
- wrong password rejected
- logout
- login again
- app restart
- session persistence
- password reset
- Owner Dashboard
- Admin Hub
- Variables
- Settings
- owner-only APIs

Remove routine dependence on passwordless owner login.

Any emergency passwordless route must be:

- server-only
- owner-controlled
- disabled by default
- time-limited
- audited
- inaccessible from the normal login screen

==================================================
12. PASSWORD RECOVERY
==================================================

Complete:

FORGOT PASSWORD
→ GENERIC SAFE RESPONSE
→ AMAZON SES EMAIL
→ RESET LINK
→ RECOVERY SESSION
→ NEW PASSWORD
→ OLD SESSIONS REVOKED
→ OLD PASSWORD REJECTED
→ NEW PASSWORD ACCEPTED
→ LOGIN
→ DASHBOARD

Test:

- owner
- member
- investor
- buyer
- JV partner
- Tokenized user
- broker
- agent
- land owner
- unknown email
- expired link
- reused link
- Android
- web
- iOS where available

Do not reveal whether an email exists.

User response:

“If an account exists, password-reset instructions have been sent.”

==================================================
13. SESSION CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Verify:

- session creation
- encrypted/secure storage
- access token refresh
- refresh token rotation
- app restart restoration
- Android process termination
- network reconnect
- expired token
- revoked token
- password-change invalidation
- logout
- logout and login again
- multiple devices
- backend restart

No tokens may appear in logs or screenshots.

==================================================
14. ROLE AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Test every protected route and API.

Required:

401:
No valid identity.

403:
Valid identity but insufficient role.

Test:

- member → owner route
- investor → owner route
- buyer → investor-private record
- JV user → another user’s documents
- altered client role
- altered user ID
- forged JWT
- expired JWT
- missing JWT
- revoked session
- malformed token

Client-side role labels do not grant access.

==================================================
15. COMPLETE AUTH API MAP
==================================================

Inspect every API, route, port, callback, and connection used by:

- registration
- login
- logout
- session
- refresh
- forgot password
- reset password
- verify email
- resend email
- role loading
- dashboard routing

Return:

DOMAIN:
PORT:
METHOD:
ROUTE:
CLIENT FILE:
BACKEND HANDLER:
SUPABASE FUNCTION:
DATABASE TABLES:
AUTH REQUIRED:
ROLE REQUIRED:
CORS:
LIVE STATUS:
HTTP RESULT:
TRACE ID:

Verify:

api.ivxholding.com
ivxholding.com
chat.ivxholding.com
Render service port
Supabase Auth
Android API base URL
iOS API base URL
web API base URL
landing registration endpoint
email callback
password reset callback
mobile deep link

==================================================
16. USER-FACING ERROR UX
==================================================

Normal users must see only safe messages:

INVALID CREDENTIALS:
“Email or password is incorrect.”

UNVERIFIED EMAIL:
“Please verify your email before signing in.”

DUPLICATE EMAIL:
“This email is already registered.”

WEAK PASSWORD:
“Use a stronger password.”

NETWORK:
“We could not connect. Please try again.”

RATE LIMIT:
“Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.”

SERVER:
“Something went wrong. Your account was not changed.”

Never show:

- AuthApiError
- stack trace
- SQL errors
- Supabase internals
- service names
- rate-limit implementation
- secret-related information

Store technical evidence privately with a trace ID.

==================================================
17. REAL EMAIL TEST ACCOUNTS
==================================================

Create approved controlled test accounts for each role.

Use Amazon SES verified recipients while in sandbox.

Required accounts:

TEST_MEMBER
TEST_INVESTOR
TEST_BUYER
TEST_JV
TEST_TOKENIZED
TEST_BROKER
TEST_AGENT
TEST_LAND_OWNER

For each:

- fresh registration
- email delivered
- email verified
- first login
- wrong password rejected
- logout/login
- password reset
- session restart
- correct dashboard
- owner routes denied

Delete or archive test records only through an approved cleanup process.

==================================================
18. DATABASE AUDIT
==================================================

Return before and after:

AUTH USERS:
PROFILES:
MEMBERS:
INVESTORS:
BUYERS:
JV PARTNERS:
TOKENIZED USERS:
BROKERS:
AGENTS:

VALID LINKS:

DUPLICATE PHONE:
ORPHAN AUTH USERS:
ORPHAN PROFILES:
ORPHAN MEMBERS:
MISSING ROLES:
INVALID ROLES:
UNCONFIRMED EMAILS:
BANNED:
DELETED:

Target after controlled test cleanup:

0 unexpected duplicates
0 unexpected orphans
0 missing required role links
0 failed registration fanouts

==================================================
19. FAILURE TEST MATRIX
==================================================

Test:

- invalid email
- weak password
- duplicate email
- duplicate phone
- missing name
- missing role
- invalid role
- malformed JSON
- double tap
- repeat request
- slow network
- offline
- DNS error
- Render cold start
- HTTP 400
- HTTP 401

- HTTP 422
- HTTP 429
- HTTP 500
- HTTP 502
- HTTP 503
- Supabase timeout
- database timeout
- email provider rejection
- bounce
- suppressed address
- expired verification link
- expired reset link

Every failure must:

- terminate loading
- avoid duplicate identity
- show safe message
- preserve appropriate form values
- provide retry
- create trace ID

==================================================
20. AUTOMATED TESTS
==================================================

Run:

- registration unit tests
- registration integration tests
- login tests
- logout tests
- session tests
- refresh tests
- verification tests
- password-reset tests
- SES adapter tests
- SMTP failure tests
- role routing tests
- authorization tests
- RLS tests
- duplicate prevention tests
- rollback tests
- CORS tests
- callback tests
- deep-link tests
- error-sanitization tests
- TypeScript
- lint
- security scan

Do not skip critical tests.

==================================================
21. PHYSICAL AND BROWSER TESTING
==================================================

Required:

- physical Android production APK
- Chrome Android
- Samsung Internet
- Instagram in-app browser
- desktop Chrome
- physical iOS/TestFlight when available
- Safari iPhone when available

Record:

DEVICE:

==================================================
22. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After all fixes:

1. Commit to owner GitHub.
2. Return full Git SHA.
3. Run all tests.
4. Deploy backend.
5. Return Render deployment ID.
6. Verify `/health`.
7. Verify runtime SHA equals GitHub SHA.
8. Deploy web/landing auth changes.
9. Invalidate CloudFront.
10. Rebuild Android production APK.
11. Increment version code.
12. Return APK URL.
13. Return APK SHA-256.
14. Install on the physical Android phone.
15. Execute the complete real-account test matrix.

==================================================
23. TEMPORARY AMAZON SES EXIT PLAN
==================================================

After authentication certification:

- document SES configuration
- document sandbox/production state
- document sending limits
- retain SES if approved
- or migrate to the final transactional email provider
- preserve templates and callback behavior
- re-run complete email certification after provider migration

Do not silently switch providers.

==================================================
STRICT VERIFIED RULE
==================================================

Return VERIFIED only when:

- every role receives and completes verification;
- every role signs in;
- every wrong password is rejected;
